lawRefs: SSA 2027 COLA and automatic determinations (announced Oct. 14, 2026)
header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Values were hand-transcribed from ssa.gov pages read in a browser (SSA blocks scripted downloads, so no raw file was hashed): the 2027 COLA fact sheet (2026 and 2027 columns: taxable maximum, quarter of coverage, earnings-test exempt amounts), oact/cola/bendpoints.html (bend points for first eligibility in the year), and oact/cola/colaseries.html. cola is the 3.6% COLA effective December 2026 (payable January 2027). earningsTest.yearOfFra applies only to months before FRA is attained ($1 withheld per $3 over; $1 per $2 under FRA). piaFactors are statutory (90% / 32% / 15%).
